title_en: Call for Entries: 2nd SNU Commons Central Library Convergence Media Works Competition
summary: Seoul National University undergraduate and graduate students, including students on leave of absence and research students, may enter the 2nd SNU Commons Central Library Convergence Media Works Competition; participation is voluntary. Entrants must submit their idea through the Google Form (https://forms.gle/6J9KXLXeLywNdErb8) during the submission period, 2 November to 29 November 2026. An optional information session will be held on 10 November 2026 at 14:00.
applies_to: Optional (voluntary competition). Open to Seoul National University undergraduate and graduate students, including students on leave of absence and research students. No prior related experience is required; an idea is sufficient.

dates.what: Submission period for competition ideas (all entrants)

conditions: Students on leave of absence and research students are eligible to enter.
No prior related experience is required; mentoring and technical support are provided.
Attendance at the information session is optional.
Ideas must be submitted through the designated Google Form.
steps: Read the detailed information at https://buly.kr/GkvNEbd.
Optionally, attend the competition information session on 10 November 2026 at 14:00 (the location is not stated in the notice; see the detailed information page).
Submit your idea through the Google Form (https://forms.gle/6J9KXLXeLywNdErb8) between 2 November and 29 November 2026.
translation:
Announcement: 2nd SNU Commons Central Library Convergence Media Works Competition

A. Event: Seoul National University SNU Commons Central Library Convergence Media Works Competition (2nd)

B. Submission period: Monday 2 November 2026 to Sunday 29 November 2026

C. Eligibility: Seoul National University undergraduate and graduate students (including students on leave of absence and research students)
- You may participate without any related experience as long as you have an idea (mentoring and technical support are provided).
- An exhibition of the works is planned at the SNU Commons Central Library, along with a special off-campus media façade exhibition.

D. How to participate: Submit your idea through the Google Form (https://forms.gle/6J9KXLXeLywNdErb8).

E. Detailed information: https://buly.kr/GkvNEbd
- A competition information session will be held (optional attendance): Tuesday 10 November 2026, 14:00
